notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest Demo 1.3 Final Update – Minor Changes
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

The final update for the Escape Zombie Maze Playtest Demo (version 1.3) is here. I’ve made minor changes to Levels 3 and 6, added a survey, and introduced small effects to enhance the experience. The HD version of the playtest demo is also available for you to play.

There will be no further updates for the playtest versions, so consider this your second demo experience. In Early Access, certain maps will be open to a certain point, with some systems yet to be implemented. Zombie behaviors are being updated, and new characters, aside from zombies, will be introduced in future updates. You’ll have access to the available sections as they are completed.

Thank you for being a part of this journey, and stay tuned for more!"

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 1.2.5.3 Update – New Icons and Final Adjustments
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

The Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 1.2.5.3 update brings new icons to the game. You should now be able to play without issues! The playtest updates will be complete after final adjustments to the effects.

A final update is also planned for the HD version. Tests will remain open, and I’ll continue providing updates on the game’s progress on the main forum page. Stay tuned for the Early Access release!

Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to follow the final updates!"

This message informs players about the update’s details and the last steps in the playtest phase.

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 1.2.5 Update – Enhancements and New Features
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

The Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 1.2.5 update brings several important changes. Here are the details of this update:

    Level 4 Corridor Update: This level has been refined to its intended state.
    Ray Tracing Added: Ray tracing has been added to enhance visual quality.
    Continue Button on Main Menu: With the increase in chapter count, this feature has become more important. Now, you won’t need to select chapters each time in Story Mode.
    Minor Map Adjustments: Small adjustments were made to improve the gameplay experience.
    Zombie Mode: This mode remains in 'free' mode, with no changes in the playtest version.
    Loading Screen Cancelled: The decision was made to drop the loading screen addition.

Additionally, the Playtest HD version is now available. If you’d like to experience the HD version, you should see two versions of the playtest in your library.

This will be one of the final updates for the playtest. After the 1.3 update, completed chapters will begin to be released in Early Access.

Thank you for your support and feedback—stay tuned for the final update!"

This announcement informs players about the HD version’s availability, along with detailed update notes, while encouraging anticipation for the upcoming 1.3 update.

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 1.2 Update – Corridor and Skybox Changes
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

In the Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 1.2 update, I’ve made a few adjustments. The corridor in Level 4 has been shortened and lighting has been added to improve visibility. Additionally, the skybox has been removed in Levels 3 and 6, giving these areas a slightly different atmosphere.

These updates are aimed at enhancing the overall gameplay experience. Your feedback is always welcome. Happy gaming!"

This message highlights the changes in the update and invites players to share their feedback.

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 1.1 Update – Bugs Fixed and Achievements Working!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

I've released the 1.1 update for the Escape Zombie Maze Playtest. In this version, bugs have been fixed, the crash issues are resolved, and Steam achievements are now working smoothly. Get ready for the full version of the game! As new chapters are completed, they will be released through future updates.

Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned!"

This message provides an update on the fixes and builds excitement for the full game release.

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 0.9 Update – Crash Issues Resolved!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

I've released the 0.9 update for the Escape Zombie Maze Playtest. This update should resolve the in-game crash issues, providing a more stable gameplay experience.

If you encounter any issues, please share your feedback. Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!"

This message announces the update, noting the crash fixes, and encourages players to continue providing feedback.

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 0.8 Update – Menu and Achievements Updated
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

I’m releasing the 0.8 update for the Escape Zombie Maze Playtest. In this update, I’ve made some changes to the menu, and about half of the achievements are active. I'm not sure if the Steam Manager will cause any errors in this version; we'll find out after the update is live. When you start the game and return to the menu, in-game movement will now be paused.

I’d appreciate your feedback, especially if you notice any issues with the Steam Manager!

Thanks for your support, and happy gaming!"

This message informs players about the update and encourages them to share feedback, particularly on potential issues.

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Playtest 0.5 Update – Achievements Partially Active
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

I’ve just released the 0.5 update for the Escape Zombie Maze Playtest. In this update, around half of the Steam achievements are active. Some crashes occurred due to adding the Steam Manager, and I’m currently working on a solution for this. If you'd prefer a smoother experience, I can open a beta version without the Steam Manager for testing purposes.

The playtest chapters are complete, and I’m in the process of testing Steam achievements. Once everything is fully functional, I'll begin working on chapters for the full release.

Thank you for your support and feedback!"

This message keeps players informed about the update's status, the issues, and the testing progress while inviting them to continue participating in the playtest.

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze Version 0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, survivors! We’ve made some improvements in this update to provide a smoother gameplay experience.

    Interface Click Bug Fixed: The interface click issue has been resolved.
    Steam Achievements: Unfortunately, some achievements are currently not working. I’m working on identifying the cause and aiming to resolve this as soon as possible.

Once these issues are fixed, I plan to begin developing the full version of the game. Thank you for your support!
